shortDescription: DNA Recruitment is a Dubai-based recruitment consultancy specializing in the life sciences and healthcare sectors.
whatTheyDo: DNA Recruitment connects healthcare and life sciences organizations across the Middle East, Africa, and Europe with specialized talent. The firm focuses on talent acquisition for pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and biotechnology. Their services include contingent and executive search, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), and market entry consulting.

shortDescription: Dozzer Middle East (DOZZER FZ-LLC) operates an online marketplace for heavy equipment, machinery, and spare parts in the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: Dozzer Middle East provides a centralized digital platform connecting equipment owners, contractors, and suppliers to buy, sell, and rent heavy machinery. In addition to online machinery and spare parts listings, the company offers technical inspection services and logistics support for equipment transport across the UAE.
